label: exempt from memory quota
type: the subject service does NOT require a memory quota - stated of the Query and Backup services.
note: Member of the Multi-Dimensional Scaling family - see provides-service. Kept as its own predicate rather than a negated requiresMemoryQuota because the docs state it as an explicit exception ('The Query and Backup services are exceptions and do not require a memory quota'), and negation-as-absence would make the exemption indistinguishable from a page that simply never mentioned quotas - which, in this corpus, is most of them.
relates_to_competency_question: What resources does adding this service cost?
